post.description: Owners whose validity started or ended since a date, or partners deregistered since a date. Rows edited in place without a date change are not detectable; diff records_list snapshots for those.

cursor.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page (the upstream `$skiptoken` Id). Pattern: ^[0-9]+$.

include_birth_date.description: Also return the full `birth_date` (personal data). Off by default: only `birth_month_year` is returned.

max_pages.description:
max_pages

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 20; default 5.

stream.description:
stream

Provider reference: allowed values ["owners", "deregistrations"]; default "owners".

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Date-based changes, built on the register's own validity dates (not a publisher delta log). `stream` `owners`: `KonecniUzivateliaVyhod?$filter=PlatnostOd ge <since> or PlatnostDo ge <since>` with partner, nationality and residence country expanded; `stream` `deregistrations`: `Partneri?$filter=Vymaz/Datum ge <since>`. Pages of 20 rows, up to `max_pages` per call; `since` is interpreted at 00:00 UTC.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `changes` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `change_kinds` | string[] |  |
| `changed_on` | string |  |
| `deregistration` | object | `Vymaz`: deregistration from the register, or null while registered. |
| `owner` | object | One beneficial-owner validity row. `birth_date` is present only when `include_birth_date` is true. `country_of_residence` is populated only where the API can expand `Adresa/Stat` (records_get, records_changes). |
| `partner` | object |  |
| `publication_id` | string | Publication pin: `partneri:le<max partner Id>:n<rows in that set>` from the Partneri entity set at the time of the call. |
| `retrieved_at` | string | UTC time of the upstream fetch, ISO 8601 (Z). |
| `source_record_id` | string | `sk:kuv:<Id>` for owner rows, `sk:rpvs:partner:<Id>` for deregistrations. |
| `source_url` | string |  |

post.description: Detail for one partner found by records_list, records_changes or search, or for a known Slovak ICO.

ico.description: Slovak company registration number (ICO); spaces are ignored. Pattern: ^[0-9 ]{6,12}$.

include_birth_date.description: Also return the full `birth_date` (personal data). Off by default: only `birth_month_year` is returned.

partner_id.description:
`Partner.Id` (not the register insert number).

Provider reference: minimum 1.

200.description:
One partner by its OData `partner_id` (`Partneri(<Id>)`) or by company registration number `ico` (`PartneriVerejnehoSektora?$filter=Ico eq '<ico>'`, then the partner). Owners come from `KonecniUzivateliaVyhod?$filter=Partner/Id eq <Id>` with `Adresa($expand=Stat)` so `country_of_residence` is filled; all pages are followed.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `beneficial_owners` | object[] |  |
| `company` | object | The company identity version of the partner; null when the register has no version rows. |
| `company_history` | object[] |  |
| `current_owner_count` | number |  |
| `deregistration` | object | `Vymaz`: deregistration from the register, or null while registered. |
| `is_registered` | boolean | No `Vymaz` row. |
| `matched_by` | string |  |
| `other_partner_ids` | number[] | Other partners that carry the same ICO (re-registrations); empty for partner_id lookups. |
| `owner_verification` | object | `OverenieIdentifikacieKUV`: the latest beneficial-owner identification verification, or null. |
| `partner_id` | number | `Partner.Id`, the OData key. |
| `portal_url` | string | Public detail page by register insert number. |
| `publication_id` | string | Publication pin: `partneri:le<max partner Id>:n<rows in that set>` from the Partneri entity set at the time of the call. |
| `register_insert_number` | number | `CisloVlozky`, the number the public portal shows. |
| `retrieved_at` | string | UTC time of the upstream fetch, ISO 8601 (Z). |
| `source_record_id` | string |  |
| `source_url` | string |  |

post.description: Full snapshot of every partner and owner. For one partner use records_get; for recent owner changes use records_changes.

cursor.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page. Carries the pin; cannot be combined with `id_from`/`id_to`. Pattern: ^v1:[0-9]+:[0-9]+:[0-9]+:[0-9]+:[0-9]+$.

id_from.description:
Segment start (partner Id, inclusive). Default 1.

Provider reference: minimum 1.

id_to.description:
Segment end (partner Id, inclusive). Default: the highest partner Id at the start of the pass.

Provider reference: minimum 1.

include_birth_date.description: Also return the full `birth_date` (personal data). Off by default: only `birth_month_year` is returned.

max_pages.description:
Upstream pages (20 partners each) to follow in this call.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 20; default 10.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
The full current list of partners (`Partneri`) with company identity versions and the complete beneficial-owner history, 20 partners per upstream page, up to `max_pages` pages per call. The cursor pins the pass to `$filter=Id le <max partner Id at start>` and the row count of that set; every call re-reads that `$count` and fails with `upstream_error` `publication_changed` if the pinned set changed. Segment by partner Id with `id_from`/`id_to` to run a pass in parallel. About 2,700 pages for the whole register.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `records` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `beneficial_owners` | object[] |  |
| `company` | object | The company identity version of the partner; null when the register has no version rows. |
| `company_history` | object[] |  |
| `current_owner_count` | number |  |
| `deregistration` | object | `Vymaz`: deregistration from the register, or null while registered. |
| `is_registered` | boolean | No `Vymaz` row. |
| `owner_verification` | object | `OverenieIdentifikacieKUV`: the latest beneficial-owner identification verification, or null. |
| `partner_id` | number | `Partner.Id`, the OData key. |
| `portal_url` | string | Public detail page by register insert number. |
| `publication_id` | string | Publication pin: `partneri:le<max partner Id>:n<rows in that set>` from the Partneri entity set at the time of the call. |
| `register_insert_number` | number | `CisloVlozky`, the number the public portal shows. |
| `retrieved_at` | string | UTC time of the upstream fetch, ISO 8601 (Z). |
| `source_record_id` | string |  |
| `source_url` | string |  |

200.description:
Partner name search over `PartneriVerejnehoSektora/ObchodneMeno` (`contains(tolower(ObchodneMeno),'<query>')`, case-insensitive); an all-digit query is matched as an exact ICO instead. Each hit is one company identity version with its partner Id. Pages of 20 hits.

post.description: Before or between records_list passes, to see whether the register moved on. In-place edits of existing rows do not change the fingerprint; use records_changes for those.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Cheap version check of the register: `$count` and the highest `Id` of the Partneri, PartneriVerejnehoSektora and KonecniUzivateliaVyhod entity sets (six small requests). The publisher exposes no ETag, Last-Modified, release date or hash, so `publication_id` is the Partneri pin `partneri:le<max Id>:n<count>` and `content_hash` is null.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `content_hash` | object | Not published; the API has no file to hash. Use `fingerprint`. |
| `entity_sets` | object[] |  |
| `file_urls` | string[] | Service root and the expanded Partneri listing records_list pages through. |
| `fingerprint` | string | `partneri:<count>:<maxId>\|pvs:<count>:<maxId>\|kuv:<count>:<maxId>`. |
| `licence_note` | string |  |
| `publication_id` | string | Publication pin: `partneri:le<max partner Id>:n<rows in that set>` from the Partneri entity set at the time of the call. |
| `published_at` | object | Not published: no global release timestamp exists. |
| `record_count` | number | Partneri `$count`. |
| `retrieved_at` | string | UTC time of the upstream fetch, ISO 8601 (Z). |
| `size_bytes` | object | Not applicable: paged API, no file. |
| `source_url` | string |  |

value.licence_note: The Ministry's open-data page (justice.gov.sk/sluzby/register-partnerov-verejneho-sektora/open-data/) offers this API for automated access but declares no explicit licence; the register is public by Act 315/2016 Coll. Owner rows are personal data (natural persons with birth dates and home addresses): birth dates are reduced to month/year unless include_birth_date is set, and street addresses are not returned.
